items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: Old man cantrell on drums. ... I was playing nice kind of right now. ... Was playing with Russian and a little six piece jazz band.

ctx.x: Do you remember did he play an E flat or B flat on the parade? E flat. E flat, the little one.

He played the E flat on the parade. The night he played the B flat. Steve Lewis was playing piano. Peter on violin. Old man cantrell on drums. He had his nephew there Charlie on guitar. He had uh, you know, he was on violin. He had uh, Bocard on trumpet. He had Warnie on trombone. Hardy had all them old fellas. Yeah, he had a pretty good lineup. He had a good lineup. Now you know, boy, I was playing nice kind of right now. Um, I call him with the Welsh there. I call that boy again, baby. Was playing with Russian…
Just a second. I'll put up a video.
